subject: CS362
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos. The English selection provided highly specific and high-quality videos for all topics. The Arabic selection was strong for core topics like Backpropagation and RNNs, but for more niche subjects like Computation Graphs and Tensor Broadcasting, broader tutorials had to be chosen as proxies due to a lack of dedicated, high-view-count videos.

coverage.topic: Recurrent Neural Networks and Backpropagation Through Time
Recurrent Neural Networks and Backpropagation Through Time
coverage.note: Several candidates failed the language gate (audio was English).

coverage.topic: Convolutional Neural Networks Math and Tensor Shapes
Convolutional Neural Networks Math and Tensor Shapes
coverage.note: A highly relevant candidate with a perfect title failed the view count gate, so a more general but popular introduction was chosen.
No eligible videos specifically on 'Computation Graphs' were found; a video on the mathematical proof of backpropagation was selected as the best proxy.
No eligible videos specifically on 'Tensors and Broadcasting' were found; a comprehensive PyTorch tutorial was selected as the best available option.
